newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX natgas called mostly flat ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX natgas called mostly flat ahead of weekend.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures were expected to open mostly unchanged Friday amid early talk of marginally softer cash prices and forecasts calling for more moderate weather by early next week, market sources said.
June over-the-counter trade ranged from $2.27 to $2.28 after settling Thursday at $2.273 per million British thermal units.
On ACCESS, June last traded 2.7 cents higher at $2.30.
Early cash prices on Transco (Station 65) were talked steady to lower around $2.28-2.30.
Technical traders said support in June was at $2.25, and then at $2.23 and $2.20. They pegged resistance in June at the new high of $2.43 and then at $2.47-50.

In Thursday's cash market, Gulf Coast swing prices were steady to down slightly around $2.30, with Hub gas mostly quoted at $2.31-2.35. Midcon pipes also were unchanged to modestly lower at $2.09-14. New York city gate gas also lost some ground to about $2.55-60.

Temperatures throughout the East and Midwest are expected to remain below normal this weekend before turning warmer early next week. In the Southwest, temperatures are forecast to remain above normal over the next few days.
